description: Show toast, platform, and in-app notifications from LWC — ShowToastEvent, lightning/platformShowToastEvent, Custom Notification types. Triggers: ShowToastEvent, toast LWC, custom notification LWC, toast not showing in Experience Cloud, lightning/toast vs platformShowToastEvent, Messaging.CustomNotification from Apex. NOT for modal overlays — use lwc/lwc-modal-and-overlay.
inputs: what user action or system event triggered the need for feedback
whether the feedback requires user acknowledgment or is purely informational
whether the component runs in Lightning Experience, Experience Cloud, or a mobile context

whether the recipient is on the page at all, or must be reached asynchronously
name: lwc-toast-and-notifications
official_sources: Toast Notifications, Lightning Web Components Developer Guide — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/lwc/guide/use-toast.html (crawled `lwc_guide use-toast L10443`–`L10467`: `lightning/toast` is the preferred method; `lightning/platformShowToastEvent` "isn't supported on login pages in Aura sites, LWR sites for Experience Cloud, and standalone apps"; inline links unsupported in the event module's title; `lightning/toast` requires `label` and treats `message` as optional; toast container defaults of 3 toasts, `top-center`, `fixed`, one instance per page, and the queue-until-dismissed behaviour)

Base Components Usage Patterns — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/lwc/guide/base-components-patterns.html (crawled `L4761`–`L4773`: `lightning/alert`, `lightning/confirm`, `lightning/prompt` require a module import; the HTML specification's deprecation of `window.alert/confirm/prompt` in third-party contexts; `.open()` does not halt execution and returns a promise; "We recommend that you use lightning/toast instead")

Base Components Categories / Status and Notification Components — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/lwc/guide/base-components-all.html (crawled `L4647`–`L4652`: first-available API versions — alert/confirm/prompt 54.0, platformShowToastEvent 45.0, toastContainer 58.0, toast 59.0 — and the LWR support line for each toast module)

Alert / Confirm / Prompt Modals — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/lwc/guide/use-dialog.html (crawled `L10396`–`L10442`: the native dialogs "aren't supported for cross-origin iframes in Chrome and Safari"; the differing parameter lists — alert `message`/`theme`/`label`, confirm `message`/`variant`/`label`, prompt `message`/`theme`/`label`/`defaultValue`; confirm resolves `true`/`false`, prompt resolves to the input value or `null`)

Style Components with Lightning Design System — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/lwc/guide/create-components-css-custom-properties.html (crawled `L1701`, `L1710`, `L1718`, `L1721`: `--slds-c-toast-*` custom properties are unsupported on `lightning/platformShowToastEvent` and supported on `lightning/toast` and `lightning/toastContainer`; component styling hooks are SLDS 1 only for now; direct SLDS class overrides are unsupported)

Test Lightning Web Components / Jest patterns — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/lwc/guide/unit-testing-using-jest-patterns.html (crawled `L12622`–`L12647`: base-component mocks match the API but not the functionality and fire no events; the grounded toast assertion `handler.mock.calls[0][0].detail.title|message|variant`; `moduleNameMapper` decides whether the import resolves to the stock `sfdx-lwc-jest` stub or a custom mock)

Configure a Component for Experience Builder + XML Configuration File Elements — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/lwc/guide/use-config-for-community-builder.html (crawled `L8106`–`L8129`, `L18700`, `L18712`, `L18722`–`L18724`, `L18781`: `lightningCommunity__Page` / `lightningCommunity__Page_Layout` / `lightningCommunity__Default` target semantics; `isExposed` plus at least one target; the Spring '25 requirement that every component specify an `apiVersion`; `datasource` renders a String property as a picklist; the restrictions on editing a live component's `.js-meta.xml`)

Apex Reference Guide, CustomNotification Class — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_apex_developer_guide.pdf (crawled `apexrefguide.txt L166555`–`L166775`: title max 250 and body max 750 characters; `send(Set<String> users)` accepts UserId/AccountId/OpportunityId/GroupId/QueueId "up to the maximum of 500 values"; `send()` throws when both `targetId` and `targetPageRef` are omitted, with `000000000000000AAA` as the documented dummy target; the Send Custom Notifications user permission requirement)

Metadata API Developer Guide, CustomNotificationType — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf (crawled `api_meta.txt L41769`–`L41893`: the `.notiftype` suffix and `notificationtypes` directory; API 46.0 and later; required `customNotifTypeName`, `masterLabel`, `desktop`, `mobile` fields and the sample definition; no wildcard support in `package.xml`)

Migrate Aura Components: component and event mapping — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/lwc/guide/migrate-map-aura-lwc-components.html (crawled `L11713`, `L11797`, `L11853`: `lightning:notificationsLibrary` is Aura-only and "LWC doesn't support notices yet"; `ShowToastEvent` "supports the same parameters, modes, and variants as Aura's showToast"; `force:showToast` maps to the `lightning/platformShowToastEvent` module)

Quick Actions and Flow Local Actions — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/lwc/guide/use-quick-actions.html (crawled `L10526`, `L10572`, `L10615`, `L8811`–`L8813`: LWC quick actions are record pages in Lightning Experience only; `CloseActionScreenEvent` from `lightning/actions` closes a screen quick action; a headless quick action can dispatch toasts; flow local actions run only in screen flows and should use `lightning/toast` on LWR sites)
